correctness.rationale: For unselected a_i and b_j the selected open-neighborhood signatures are J\{i} and I\{j} in opposite labeled shores. Pairwise uniqueness and nonemptiness yield exactly the stated four occupancy regimes. The all-set polynomial comes from four states per matched index with at most one empty and exact subtraction of both low-occupancy regimes. For n>=5 a two-shore code has an n-1-vertex disjoint two-shore subcode by a two-request-per-shore Hall argument; one-shore minimal cases are explicit. n=4 is counted separately. The standard-library verifier directly checks all 349440 subsets at n=4..9, including every coefficient and minimal-code family. No finite data are used to infer the unrestricted theorem.

value.rationale: Fault localization is the intrinsic motivation of locating domination. This is a full exact polynomial on a highly symmetric family, not just a minimum number. It determines all irredundant sensor placements in a separate two-layer polynomial, with sharply classified structures and exponentially many optimum placements; the exceptional n=4 case is resolved. An exact natural invariant and complete minimal-code classification have plausible downstream use in sampling, reliability, and sensor redundancy. No stronger implication or arbitrary parameter slicing is assumed.
